rooms.name: Gates of Barovia
rooms.desc: Behind you the fog has closed over the road. Ahead, grey stone piers rise out of the forest on either side with tall rusted iron gates hung between them, and two stone guardians flank the way, both headless, their heads lying in the grass at their feet.
rooms.dm: On foot, the gates screech open as the party approaches and shut behind it; Vistani wagons: they open before the lead wagon and close after the last. This (eastern) gate will not open for anyone leaving unless Vistani are with them. If Strahd is destroyed the gates swing open and the road east clears of fog.

objects.label: Gates of Barovia
objects.desc: Massive grey piers of stone stand out of the forest either side of the road, a pair of tall, rusted iron gates hung between them.

objects.label: Headless guardian
objects.desc: A stone guardian, armed and armoured, larger than life. Its head is gone, broken off at the neck.

objects.label: Fallen stone head
objects.desc: A guardian's helmeted head lies in the weeds, staring at nothing.

objects.label: Headless guardian
objects.desc: A stone guardian, armed and armoured, larger than life. Its head is gone, broken off at the neck.

objects.label: Fallen stone head
objects.desc: A guardian's helmeted head lies in the weeds, staring at nothing.

objects.label: The Mists
objects.desc: Fog rolls out of the trees and closes over the road behind you.

objects.label: Skirting the closed gates through the woods means walking into the Mists: the fog chokes any non-Vistani who tries.

The Mists: a creature starting its turn in the fog makes a DC 20 Con save or gains a level of exhaustion (not removable while in the fog); the area is heavily obscured; whoever walks into it is turned around and comes out in Barovia again.
West: the road runs on through the Svalich Woods (C) to the village of Barovia (E).
